versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated model endpoint in documentation from u1-insuremed to u2-med.
- No functional changes to skill logic or interface.

Initial release summary: Provides patient-side post-surgery rehab progress tracking, referencing progress analysis from rehabilitation-analyzer.

- Enables visualization of rehab progress, trends, and adherence for patients.
- Accepts multiple input formats (JSON, CSV, Excel, text, images, PDF, Word).
- Processes rehab task records, pain scores, and functional self-assessments.
- Outputs structured data and markdown/natural language summaries for end-user display.
- Strictly summarizes and visualizes progress, without clinical decision or recommendation functions.
- Requires external API and authentication for model-based analysis.
